subject: Publication objects for SyncGTM enrichments
body:
SyncGTM's docs enumerate 50+ data providers, 70+ enrichment fields and a 75+ action library, and you already ship an MCP server of your own. In the newsletter layer your category is measured: Clay sits in 92 articles across 56 publications and Apollo in 102 across 88, while SyncGTM does not appear yet.

That layer is what NewsletterFIT supplies: publication identity, audience, topics, the sponsors running in the list, momentum, and the article behind each fact, all extracted by AI from the issue text.

As a field set it lands as an enrichment action rather than a corpus: query by domain or publication over REST, or through the MCP endpoint your library already calls. At two to ten people, licensing this beats building an ingest pipeline.

I can send a sample of the fields for one segment before anything is wired.
